accessibility.info:
All Patrons Require Ticket. Rain or Shine.

The Tuscaloosa Amphitheater implements a clear bag policy to promote safety and faster entry into the venue. Clear totes are permitted that have a logo only on one side and items within the bag must be loose. Tote must be 12"x12"x8" or smaller. Clear plastic resealable bags are permitted no larger than 1 gallon. Clutch, small purse & wallets are permitted if they are approximately the size of a hand, no larger than 6.5"x4.5". May include a handle or strap. For complete information, please visit TuscaloosaAmphitheater.com.
